# Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT)

> > Rochester Institute of Technology is a nationally ranked innovation university offering cooperative education, cutting-edge research in AI and quantum computing, and specialized facilities spanning engineering, design, and cybersecurity.

RIT is recognized by U.S. News & World Report for its top-ranked co-op/internship programs and innovation initiatives. The university houses specialized research centers like the RIT Center for Human-aware AI led by Andreas Savakis, advanced facilities including the Davenport-Hatch Security Lab and New Media Design Workshop, and offers unique programs through NTID and the School of Individualized Study.

## Key Topics

- Cooperative education and internships
- Human-aware AI and trustworthy AI research
- Quantum computing and photonics
- Cybersecurity and digital security
- Innovation and rankings
- STEM education and coding
- Computer engineering and electronics design
- New media design and AR/VR
- 3D printing and makerspaces
- NTID (National Technical Institute for the Deaf)
- Academic Success Center
- Research facilities and labs
- Booth Hall facilities
- Student learning centers
- Individualized study programs

## Rankings and Recognition

- [RIT Ranked 5th Among College Co-op/Internship Programs](https://www.rit.edu/best-co-op-internship): U.S. News ranks RIT 5th nationally for cooperative education programs
- [Rankings and Recognition](https://www.rit.edu/rankings-and-recognition): U.S. News rankings highlight RIT's innovation, co-op, and game design

## Research Centers and Advanced Labs

- [RIT Center for Human-aware AI](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/rit-center-human-aware-ai): Research center led by Andreas Savakis focusing on trustworthy AI
- [Manifesting Quantum](https://www.rit.edu/news/manifesting-quantum): RIT quantum research advances photonics, computing, and cybersecurity
- [Davenport-Hatch Foundation, Inc. Security Lab](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/davenport-hatch-foundation-inc-security-lab): Cybersecurity lab with virtual computing and security exercise workstations
- [Electronics Design Automation Lab](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/electronics-design-automation-lab): EDA lab for electronics design, signals, and networking courses

## Design and Makerspace Facilities

- [New Media Design Workshop](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/new-media-design-workshop): Makerspace for 3D printing, AR/VR, and physical computing in Booth Hall
- [Furniture Design Machine Room](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/furniture-design-machine-room): Woodworking and furniture design studio facility in Booth Hall

## Student Support and Learning Resources

- [Academic Support](https://www.rit.edu/academic-support): Tutoring, advising, and student success resources at Academic Success Center
- [Gelsomino Family Student Learning Center (3120)](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/gelsomino-family-student-learning-center-3120): 24-hour study lounge and tutoring space in Lowenthal Hall
- [Request Information](https://www.rit.edu/request-information): Admissions inquiry forms for undergraduate, graduate, and NTID programs

## News and Student Stories

- [Teaching STEM by Playing with Primates](https://www.rit.edu/news/zoo): Prof. DeLong combines coding education with primate research at Seneca Zoo
- [More Than One Path](https://www.rit.edu/faces/more-one-path): Berta Rivera's journey through School of Individualized Study program
- [Where Science Meets Art](https://www.rit.edu/faces/where-science-meets-art): Zayneb Jaff's dual major in health studies and jewelry design for med school

## Optional

- [Red Barn](https://www.rit.edu/facilities/red-barn): Indoor rock climbing and bouldering recreation facility for students
- [Copyright Infringement](https://www.rit.edu/copyright-infringement): DMCA compliance policy and copyright infringement reporting procedures
